comment: Blocked: needs a general Lua runtime in the port and the nh.gettrap/nh.abscoord bindings. Debug-mode #wizloadlua ../home/.nethackrc runs Lua from the rc file; in C this runs sp_lev.c get_trapname_bytype, nhl_abs_coord and other binding lines no installed Lua reaches (blind review c blocks 320, 327-329, 331-333). See recipes/nhlua.c/rc-file-run-as-lua.

segments.nethackrc:
--[[
OPTIONS=name:Luaspl,role:Valkyrie,race:human,gender:female,align:neutral
OPTIONS=!legacy,!tutorial,!splash_screen,pettype:none,!autopickup
OPTIONS=playmode:debug
]]
local ax, ay = nh.abscoord(5, 5)
local p = nh.abscoord({ x = 6, y = 6 })
nh.pline("abs " .. ax .. "," .. ay .. " " .. p.x .. "," .. p.y)
des.trap({ type = "board", x = 10, y = 10 })
local t = nh.gettrap(10, 10)
if t then nh.pline("trap " .. t.ttyp_name) end
des.grave(12, 12, "rc grave")
des.grave({ x = 14, y = 12, text = "table grave" })
des.grave({ text = "random grave" })
des.mineralize({ gem_prob = 10, gold_prob = 20 })
des.feature({ type = "fountain", x = 16, y = 12, looted = true, warned = false })
des.feature({ type = "sink", x = 18, y = 12, pudding = "no", dishwasher = true, ring = false })
des.feature({ type = "throne", x = 20, y = 12, looted = true })
des.feature({ type = "tree", x = 22, y = 12, looted = false, swarm = true })
des.wall_property({ x1 = 0, y1 = 0, x2 = 79, y2 = 20, property = "nonpasswall" })
des.wall_property({ x1 = -1, y1 = -1, x2 = 10, y2 = 10, property = "nondiggable" })

nh.pline("lua part done")
